string_format.description: Channel Mapping: A0 = NH3, A1 = H2S OP1 (WE), A2 = H2S OP2 (AE), A3 = VOC

calibration.note: Alphasense calibration values only. source 'factory' = the sensor's own Alphasense factory calibration sheet; source 'datasheet' = Alphasense's published typical values for the sensor type, used until the factory sheet is entered (indicative). H2S (ppb) = ((A1 - WE zero) - (A2 - AE zero)) / sensitivity; NH3 (ppm) = (A0 - WE zero) / sensitivity; VOC (ppm) = (A3 - V zero) / sensitivity. No temperature tables, filtering or smoothing.

h2s.sheet_values: Factory sheet: WE (OP1) zero 395 mV, AE (OP2) zero 362 mV, sensitivity 1.727952 mV/ppb = 1727.952 mV/ppm. H2S (ppm) = ((OP1 mV - 395) - (OP2 mV - 362)) / 1727.952.

nh3.sheet_values: WE zero 328 mV; 73.28 nA/ppm x 0.8 mV/nA (ISB gain) = 58.624 mV/ppm

voc.sheet_values: PIDX-A-040 datasheet: offset voltage 40-100 mV (midpoint 70 mV used); typical sensitivity 55 mV/ppm +/-10%; output signal from 0.040 V (below = fault). Replace with the PID factory sheet.
